name: Golden Spatula
body:
Aura faint conjuration; CL 5th; Slot none; Price 10,150 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

This item was used by an ancient ship’s cookie that sailed the seas for years before his ship was lost. Lost for years unknown, the golden spatula has returned to the culinary world. The spatula holds an enchantment which grants the user a +10 competence bonus to Profession (cook) checks.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells create food and water; Cost 5,150 gp
